qualifier: sulfur, aromatic and serine/threonine amino acids; vitamin B6 and BH4
name: Sulfur, aromatic and serine-family amino acid and cofactor metabolism
rationale: Members cover catabolism and synthesis of sulfur (cysteine, transsulfuration, sulfide), aromatic (Phe/Tyr, PKU), serine/threonine/glycine, histidine and proline plus B6, BH4 and molybdenum cofactors, unlike confusables centred on glutamate/aspartate nitrogen, mitochondrial organic acids, glycine conjugation or alanine.

qualifier: hexosamine and sialic acid synthesis with N-glycan processing
name: Hexosamine and sialic acid metabolism with N-glycan processing
rationale: Members share GlcNAc/UDP-GlcNAc, sialic acid and mannose/glucose sugar-precursor metabolism feeding N-glycan processing and lysosomal oligosaccharide breakdown, whereas confusables emphasise GDP-mannose, nucleotide-sugar transport, glycan antenna/fucose/O-glycan elongation or GPI anchors.

qualifier: Sanfilippo (MPS III) and Morquio (MPS IV) types
name: Sanfilippo and Morquio mucopolysaccharidoses
rationale: All members are MPS IIIA-D or MPS IVA/B lysosomal storage disorders, distinguishing the theme from confusables containing Hurler, Hunter, Sly, Maroteaux-Lamy, Natowicz and generic GAG degradation.

qualifier: FGFR1-3 fusions and amplifications
name: Oncogenic FGFR fusion and amplification signaling
rationale: All members are signaling by FGFR1/2/3 fusion or amplification mutants in cancer, unlike confusables about KIT/PDGFR, ALK/LTK or EGFR/ERBB2 mutants.

qualifier: metaphase-to-anaphase transition and its inhibition
name: Control of meiotic metaphase-to-anaphase transition
rationale: All three members concern the meiotic metaphase/anaphase transition and its negative regulation (chromosome separation), unlike confusables on meiotic cohesion and alignment, mitotic spindle checkpoint or oocyte meiosis I and spindle positioning.

qualifier: DNA glycosylase lesion recognition and excision, including glycosylase defects
name: DNA glycosylase-initiated base excision repair and its defects
rationale: Members cover glycosylase recognition and cleavage of damaged purines/pyrimidines and defective OGG1, MUTYH, NTHL1, NEIL1/3 variants, whereas confusables cover downstream AP-site processing, gap filling and long-patch repair.

qualifier: VEGFR2/neuropilin and Tie2 signaling with restraint of sprouting
name: VEGFR/Tie2 endothelial signaling and sprouting angiogenesis inhibition
rationale: Members share VEGF-VEGFR2/neuropilin and Tie2 receptor signaling, negative regulation of sprouting, endothelial chemotaxis and VEGF responses, and endothelial junction control, unlike confusables focused on endothelial differentiation/vasculogenesis or positive angiogenic regulation.

core: Rho GTPase signaling to ROCK and PAK
qualifier: via G alpha 12/13 GPCRs, Sema4D and Rnd GTPases
name: Rho-ROCK signaling via Galpha12/13, Sema4D and Rnd GTPases
rationale: Members share Rho pathway activation by G alpha 12/13 GPCRs and Sema4D plus Rnd1-3 cycles and ROCK/PAK effectors, unlike confusables on Sema3A repulsion, Rac/Cdc42 cycles or filopodia and ephrin signaling.

core: Cation-coupled ion transport and its disorders
qualifier: SLC12 cation-chloride cotransporters and SLC9 Na+/H+ exchangers
name: Cation-chloride cotransporter and Na+/H+ exchanger defects
rationale: Members share SLC12 chloride cotransporters (Bartter, Gitelman, ACCPN) and SLC9 sodium/proton exchangers (autism, Christianson) with potassium channels and anion homeostasis, unlike confusables on SLC26/SLC4 anion exchangers, osmosensing or sodium transport regulation.

core: Viral life cycle regulation in host
qualifier: entry, genome replication and release, independent of interferon
name: Host regulation of viral entry, replication and release
rationale: Members share host- and virus-driven control of viral entry, replication, protein levels and release, lacking the interferon/ISG15 signatures of most confusables and the endocytic attachment steps of the entry confusable.

qualifier: netrin and Sema3A-plexin repulsion
name: Netrin and Sema3A-plexin axon guidance and chemorepulsion
rationale: Members share axon guidance and extension control through netrin and Sema3A/plexin repulsive signaling (CRMPs, PAK, integrin inhibition), unlike confusables built on ephrin, L1, DCC attraction, Sema4D or collateral sprouting.

qualifier: COPI retrograde transport and TGN-endolysosomal sorting
name: COPI and TGN-endolysosome vesicle traffic through the Golgi
rationale: Members share Golgi-centred vesicle budding and transport, including COPI Golgi-to-ER and intra-Golgi traffic, TGN-to-lysosome sorting and endosome-to-Golgi retrieval, unlike confusables on endocytic recycling, Golgi structure/reassembly or COPII ER export.

qualifier: BMAL1:CLOCK and CRY:PER transcriptional feedback
name: Core circadian clock BMAL1:CLOCK-CRY:PER transcriptional loop
rationale: Members share the core clock feedback loop (BMAL1/CLOCK/NPAS2 activation, CRY:PER repression and degradation, entrainment), unlike confusables centred on PPAR/PGC-1alpha/REV-ERB metabolic regulation or MECP2/NPAS4 neuronal transcription.

qualifier: proton-coupled di- and oligopeptide uptake
name: Proton-coupled di- and oligopeptide transport
rationale: All members concern proton/oligopeptide cotransport of di- and oligopeptides across the plasma membrane, unlike confusables on amino acid transporters or NOD-mediated muramyl dipeptide sensing.

qualifier: Pol II/Pol III snRNA gene transcription and spliceosome assembly
name: snRNA gene transcription and spliceosomal pre-mRNA splicing
rationale: Members share snRNA production (Pol II and type 3 Pol III transcription, cap hypermethylation) and spliceosome assembly and splicing, unlike confusables on Pol III tRNA transcription, nuclear RNA decay or snRNP assembly/histone mRNA processing.

qualifier: netrin-mediated, without semaphorin signaling
name: Netrin-mediated axon guidance and chemorepulsion
rationale: Members share netrin signaling, axon chemorepulsion and extension control, including dopaminergic, serotonergic and DRG axons, and lack the Sema3A/plexin members of the closest confusable.

qualifier: GLUT4 translocation with adiponectin and muscle activity
name: GLUT4-mediated glucose uptake regulated by adiponectin and exercise
rationale: Members share regulation of plasma-membrane glucose import via GLUT4/RHOQ translocation, insulin sensitisation, adiponectin and muscle-activity/PGC-1alpha signals, unlike confusables on insulin secretion, glucagon/gluconeogenesis or adipogenic transcription.

qualifier: peroxisomal protein import plus fatty acid oxidation and ether lipid synthesis
name: Peroxisomal protein import and fatty acid/ether lipid metabolism
rationale: Members share peroxisome biogenesis and import with peroxisomal alpha/beta-oxidation of very-long, branched and medium-chain fatty acids, VLCFA elongation and plasmalogen synthesis, unlike confusables on bile acid or cholesterol synthesis.

qualifier: desmosomes and hemidesmosomes linked to intermediate filaments
name: Desmosome and hemidesmosome intermediate-filament junction assembly
rationale: Members share assembly of intermediate-filament-anchored desmosomes and hemidesmosomes in epithelial and cardiac cell adhesion, unlike confusables on adherens junctions/cadherins and polarity or skin cornification.

qualifier: circulating monocyte and resting dendritic cell surface programs
name: Circulating monocyte and resting dendritic cell surface signatures
rationale: Members share blood monocyte, dendritic cell and neutrophil enrichment signatures and surface markers, unlike confusables on antigen processing/presentation, CD1 and TLR7, or monocyte activation and lineage transcription.

qualifier: ISG15-mediated restriction of viral invasion and release
name: ISG15 and interferon-stimulated restriction of viral spread
rationale: Members share IFN-alpha-stimulated antiviral effectors, notably ISG15 conjugation, that suppress viral invasion and release, unlike confusables dominated by IFN signatures, OAS/PKR and IFN signaling regulation, or generic ubiquitination.

qualifier: amyloid-beta clearance and fibril formation
name: Amyloid-beta clearance and amyloid fibril formation control
rationale: All members concern amyloid-beta clearance or positive/negative regulation of amyloid fibril formation, unlike confusables centred on microglial activation, differentiation and cytotoxicity.

qualifier: factor VIII and factor IX variants
name: Factor VIII and IX defects in intrinsic coagulation
rationale: Members are defective F8 and F9 variants (hemophilia A/B, FIX thrombophilia) plus the intrinsic pathway, unlike confusables on the full coagulation cascade, fibrinolysis, FXII/kallikrein, VWF or FV defects.

qualifier: glial proliferation and survival with amyloid-beta and tau pathology
name: Glial activation and proliferation in amyloid and tau neurodegeneration
rationale: Members share regulation of microglial and astrocyte activation, glial proliferation/apoptosis and nerve regeneration alongside amyloid-beta production/clearance and tangle assembly, unlike confusables centred on microglial immune function, Abeta clearance or APP processing.

qualifier: proximal-distal patterning and comma/S-shaped body morphogenesis
name: Nephron proximal-distal patterning and S-shaped body morphogenesis
rationale: Members share nephron patterning and tubule morphogenesis through comma- and S-shaped body stages, unlike confusables on intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct, renal vesicle/MET or ureteric bud development.
